audit.notes: The new chapter blocks comprehensively cover all scientifically useful content present in the old draft. Specific mechanisms (Fourier optics, Bessel function PSF), architectural comparisons (single-plane vs. multi-layer, alignment sensitivity/vaccination), training methodologies (differentiability, back-propagation, hybridization), physical constraints (Abbe-Rayleigh limit, superoscillation), and applications (polarization multiplexing, speckle decryption, compressive sensing) are all retained or improved upon in the new text with appropriate evidence handles.
